tips.text: Train from Vienna (Wien Hbf) to St. Pölten Hbf takes ~30 min. Regular services run throughout the day.
Shuttle buses run from St. Pölten Hbf to the festival grounds. Free with ticket wristband.
Daypark (Space Stage + Green Stage): runs ~14:00–22:00. Rock, indie, pop acts.
Nightpark: separate venue area, opens ~22:00 until ~05:00. Electronic, DJ sets.
The walk between Daypark and Nightpark areas is ~5–10 min.
